papers.title: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection
papers.summary_en: RoboJev-27B adapts JEV-27B-VL with language-only rank-32 LoRA and source-specific KL anchoring, then predicts success with a calibrated two-token readout from ten primary frames plus available auxiliary final frames. Only 80/268 SO-101 episodes are held-out tasks. API baselines receive four primary frames, so frontier comparisons are not input-matched. Cost excludes media/serving overhead; community labels have one annotator; calibration and safety transfer are unestablished.
papers.summary_zh: RoboJev-27B对JEV-27B-VL作语言侧rank-32 LoRA及来源专属KL约束，以校准双token读出判断成功，输入10张主相机帧及可用辅助相机末帧。 SO-101仅80/268条为未见任务；API对照只用4张主帧，前沿模型比较输入不匹配。成本不含媒体/服务开销；社区标签仅一位标注者，跨域校准及安全性未证实。

papers.title: RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: RoboDuo lets a full-task VLA attempt the task, checks completion, then uses a separately trained atomic VLA through generated code to recover unfinished steps while keeping the full-task policy frozen. Not training-free overall: atomic policy and completion-checking coding agent use derived demonstration datasets. Gains shrink with five-suite training; real evaluation is one task family with small counts. Published reference rows use different protocols and are not matched reruns.
papers.summary_zh: RoboDuo先让整任务VLA尝试并检查完成情况，再通过生成代码调用另行训练的原子VLA补齐剩余步骤，整任务策略冻结。 整体并非免训练：原子策略及完成检查编码代理使用示范派生数据集。五套件训练时收益缩小；真机仅一个任务族、小样本。公开参考行协议不同，非匹配重跑。

papers.title: ThinkLocoManip: A Whole-Body Control Agentic Harness for Legged Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary_en: ThinkLocoManip interleaves reasoning and action over perception, navigation, manipulation and whole-body locomotion tools; keyframe thinking retains execution context for recovery. Five task families on one platform, 10–20 trials per task. Tool orchestration includes engineered navigation/grasp/control capabilities; these results do not isolate cross-episode skill acquisition or establish portability of the whole-body controller.
papers.summary_zh: ThinkLocoManip交替推理/行动，编排感知、导航、操作及全身运动工具；关键帧思考保留执行上下文以恢复失败。 仅单平台5类任务，每类10–20次；编排依赖工程化导航、抓取及控制工具，未隔离跨回合技能获取，也未证明全身控制器可迁移。

papers.title: How High Can GPT-6 Astra Climb in Contact-Rich Manipulation? PhysLadder: A Hierarchical, Matched Sim-Real Benchmark for Physical Interaction
papers.summary_en: PhysLadder defines 16 matched sim/real contact-rich tasks at three cumulative levels: contact geometry, sustained force regulation, and force regulation coordinated with contact reconfiguration. One model and very small per-task samples; agreement does not establish universal sim-to-real ranking validity. Simulation contact/material parameters are not measured physical properties; real and simulated model-call counts use different action interfaces.
papers.summary_zh: PhysLadder定义16项仿真/真机匹配接触任务，递进考察接触几何、持续力调节、以及接触重配置与力调节协同。 单模型、每任务极少样本；一致性不等于普适仿真到真机排序有效。仿真接触/材料参数并非实测物理值，模型调用数受不同动作接口影响，不可直接比较。

papers.title: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
papers.summary_en: RobotAgentBench evaluates task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, recovery and robustness plus open-ended household scenarios, comparing coding, learned and hybrid planning/execution/verification architectures. Scores are capability/scenario aggregates, not a universal task success rate. Main results are simulation; matched physical subsets cover only selected systems, not the best hybrid/RSI rows. Open-ended scores remain low and standalone versus agents differ in interfaces.
papers.summary_zh: RobotAgentBench在家庭场景评估任务发现、情境推理、操作、恢复及鲁棒性，并比较编码、学习及混合规划/执行/验证架构。 这些是能力/场景聚合分数，非统一成功率；主表来自仿真，匹配真机子集仅覆盖部分系统、不含最优混合/RSI行。开放场景得分仍低，独立策略和代理接口不同。

papers.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
papers.summary_en: VISTA evolves executable robot-agent harnesses using an ancestry graph, active diagnostic interactions and fresh autonomous evaluation of frozen candidate packages, without updating model weights. Simulation only. Task-specific selection and best-so-far curves do not prove unseen-task generalization or monotonic candidate improvement. Up to 100 planner turns and 10,000 physics steps on LIBERO-Pro/RoboTwin; development compute is substantial and baseline budgets must not be assumed matched.
papers.summary_zh: VISTA利用版本谱系图、主动诊断交互及冻结候选包的新自主评估迭代可执行机器人harness，不更新模型权重。 仅仿真。任务专属选择及历史最优曲线不证明未见任务泛化或每次候选单调改善。LIBERO-Pro/RoboTwin最多100轮规划、10000物理步；开发计算量巨大，不应默认对照预算匹配。

papers.title: RetroNav: Scene-Grounded Retrospection and Retry for Self-Evolving Lifelong Navigation
papers.summary_en: RetroNav links geometric/semantic scene evidence to historical decisions, uses an independent evaluator to request retries, and writes evidence-grounded retry briefs without model training. Benchmark subsets, not full splits: IR2R 299 episodes/three scenes, GOAT 307 subtasks/five scenes. Retries reset to the original pose with a renewed step budget; reset travel is uncharged. Cross-task memory is disabled on three episodic benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: RetroNav将几何/语义场景证据关联历史决策，由独立评估器决定重试，并生成有证据的重试简报，无需模型训练。 使用子集而非完整划分：IR2R299回合/3场景、GOAT307子任务/5场景；重试回到起点并重获步数预算，重置移动不计费。三个单回合基准禁用跨任务记忆。

papers.title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
papers.summary_en: EmbodiedLab requires agents to discover unknown quantitative properties through physically operating simulated instruments; success checks answers, episode-grounded measurements and required physical state. Entirely simulated science apparatus; evaluates model plus native coding harness rather than model alone. Skill recipients differ from teacher agents, and small experiment counts limit precision. Reference solvability does not imply physical-lab transfer.
papers.summary_zh: EmbodiedLab要求代理通过操作仿真仪器发现未知定量属性，同时检查答案、回合内测量证据及所需物理状态。 完全仿真的科学装置；评估模型加原生编码harness而非孤立模型。技能接收者与教师代理不同，实验数量有限；参考程序可解不代表真机实验室迁移。

papers.title: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
papers.summary_en: RoboDoctor connects diagnosis, policy/agent control allocation, selective intervention and contact-method revision through persistent records of rationale, attempted methods, outcomes and reuse conditions. Retrospective highest-score selection mixes source runs without uniform versions, checkpoints or inference budgets. Warmup already uses assistance and memory. No matched reset-memory control, consolidated cost analysis or real-robot validation; results do not establish causal memory benefit.
papers.summary_zh: RoboDoctor通过持久化理由、尝试方法、结果及复用条件，将诊断、策略/代理控制分配、选择性干预及接触方法修订串联。 回溯性最高分选择混合多个来源运行，版本、checkpoint和推理预算不统一。暖启动已含协助及记忆；无匹配重置记忆对照、完整成本核算或真机验证，不能证明记忆的因果收益。

papers.title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
papers.summary_en: ZAP trains a 27B VLM via successful-trace SFT and simulation GRPO to use a shared perception/pose-control tool interface; semantic pretraining and learned motion are tested compositionally without real robot training trajectories. Only 30 real trials/model. Harness supplies SAM3.1 segmentation, calibrated depth-derived 3D readouts and controller feedback; not RGB-only end-to-end control. Real robot calibration informs simulation. Cost assumes one B300 at $7.10/hour; Franka transfer is not real hardware.
papers.summary_zh: ZAP以成功轨迹SFT和仿真GRPO训练27B VLM使用统一感知/位姿控制工具接口，测试语义预训练与动作学习的组合泛化，不用真机训练轨迹。 每模型仅30次真机试验；harness提供SAM3.1分割、校准深度3D读数及控制反馈，非纯RGB端到端控制。仿真使用真机校准；成本按每小时7.10美元单B300计算；Franka迁移并非真机。

papers.title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
papers.summary_en: EBench profiles Astra direct waypoint control versus selective invocation of frozen VLA/WAM policies under RGB/proprioceptive observations and one annotated demonstration per task. No cross-episode memory. 31/510 episodes use a demonstration from the same test scene. Two tasks allow 3,000 steps direct versus 5,000 hybrid; correcting that changes hybrid means to 52.4%/55.8%. Policy calls cannot receive agent-written subgoals; compute is unbounded and comparisons run once/episode.
papers.summary_zh: EBench在RGB/本体观测及每任务一个标注示范下，对比Astra直接路点控制与选择性调用冻结VLA/WAM。 无跨回合记忆；31/510回合使用同测试场景示范。两任务直接3000步、混合5000步，按3000步对齐混合均值52.4%/55.8%。策略调用不能传代理子目标；计算量无上限，每回合仅一次运行。

papers.title: Execution Logs Sway VLM Judges of Robot Progress
papers.summary_en: Controlled contradictory execution-log lines test whether VLM robot-progress judges follow text rather than visual evidence; a short unreliability warning is evaluated as mitigation. Conditional selected-clip effects, not population-wide failure rates; completion-claim search differs from the fixed-log test and was not tested on Sol. Warnings reduce misleading-log effects but also reduce benefits from accurate logs.
papers.summary_zh: 以受控矛盾执行日志测试VLM机器人进度评估器是否舍弃视觉而追随文字，并评估简短不可靠性警告。 效果条件于筛选片段，不是总体失败率；完成声明搜索与固定日志测试不同，也未在Sol测试。警告虽缓解误导日志，也削弱正确日志收益。

papers.title: Evolving to Match Capabilities: Improving Harness Self-Evolution via Skill Adaptation
papers.summary_en: Skill Adaptation turns diagnosed executor weaknesses into a meta-skill for rewriting procedural skills, then compares one-shot rewriting and five rounds of feedback-driven self-evolution across executor capacities. Non-robotic STEM/document/developer tasks, selected from 607 tasks for skill sensitivity. Each evolution round runs once; small gaps have no repeated-run uncertainty estimate. Skills are already in context, so retrieval, progressive disclosure and closed-loop physical transfer are untested.
papers.summary_zh: Skill Adaptation将执行器弱点诊断转为改写程序性技能的meta-skill，比较一次改写及五轮反馈式自进化，跨执行器能力评估。 非机器人STEM/文档/开发任务，从607项按技能敏感性筛选。每轮仅运行一次，小差值无重复运行不确定性；技能预置上下文，未测检索、渐进披露或物理闭环迁移。

papers.title: Gaussian Episodic Memory for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Reasoning
papers.summary_en: GEMS stores localized changes in a persistent temporal 3D Gaussian map and lets an agent retrieve, render novel views and compare revisits through a finite-state tool interface. Reported QA percentages are rescaled 1–5 judge scores, not binary exact-match accuracy. Three real scenes, pose/depth noise and novel-view artifacts; real score is below all-images. Storage comparison covers one scene per split and does not show online robot-policy gains.
papers.summary_zh: GEMS在持久时序3D高斯地图中仅存局部变化，代理通过有限状态工具接口检索、渲染新视角并跨重访比较。 问答百分比是1–5裁判评分归一化，非二元精确正确率。仅3个真实场景，位姿/深度噪声和新视角伪影使真实分数低于全图基线；存储对比每划分一个场景，未证在线策略收益。

papers.title: MOON: Learning When to Forget and How to Move On in Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.summary_en: MOON adds a deviation judge and GRPO-trained recovery adapter to a frozen vision-language navigation policy: an alarm clears visual history once, then recovery learns to escape history-induced behavioral inertia. Simulation only; deployment tested on one backbone and trains two adapters, not training-free. Alarm operating levels were selected on the reported evaluation splits. Clearing breaks 5.8%/4.1% of base-success episodes on R2R/RxR; successful forgetting is not evidence that long-term skill memory should be deleted.
papers.summary_zh: MOON给冻结视觉语言导航策略增加偏航裁判和GRPO恢复适配器：警报触发一次视觉历史清除，再由恢复策略摆脱历史导致的行为惯性。 仅仿真，部署只测一基座并训练两个适配器，并非免训练。警报工作点在所报告评测划分上选择。清除使R2R/RxR原本成功回合中的5.8%/4.1%失败；有效遗忘不等于应删除长期技能记忆。

papers.title: FISRF: Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework for Robotics Task Planning with Large Language Model
papers.summary_en: FISRF combines short-term trajectories/reflections with cross-task failure lessons and a fixed RAG mentor knowledge base; measured recovery difficulty and improvement choose which reflection or guidance to request. Quantitative evidence is text simulation; the dual-arm mobile-robot kitchen demonstration has no reported trial count or comparative success rate. Planning epochs are iterative recovery rather than independent seeds. Reported reflection cost is tokens per recovered task, not total deployment dollars; isolated long-term transfer and uncertainty remain unclear.
papers.summary_zh: FISRF结合短期轨迹/反思、跨任务失败教训及固定RAG导师知识库，根据恢复难度和改善程度选择反思或求助策略。 定量证据来自文本仿真；双臂移动机器人厨房演示未报告试验数或对比成功率。规划轮次是迭代恢复而非独立种子。反思成本为每个恢复任务的token，不是总部署美元；独立长期迁移及不确定性仍不清楚。

papers.title: MemVLN: Streaming Episodic Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.summary_en: MemVLN compresses episode-local visual features with timestamps and action-derived poses into a bounded bank and 300 cross-attention memory tokens, combining a frozen geometry encoder with trained memory, adapters and trajectory-summarization supervision. Memory is episode-local, not cross-task skill accumulation. Real tests share one scene with 24 post-training demonstrations; only six distinct test instructions, no cross-scene validation. Gains combine geometry and auxiliary training; RxR geometry-only success (56.3%) exceeds the full model. Fixed-input RTX4090 latency rises 503.2→691.0 ms.
papers.summary_zh: MemVLN将回合内带时间及动作推算位姿的视觉特征压缩进有限记忆库，并读出300个交叉注意力记忆token；结合冻结几何编码器、可训练记忆/适配器与轨迹摘要监督。 记忆仅回合内，非跨任务技能积累。真机与24条后训练示范共用一个场景，仅6条不同测试指令，无跨场景验证。收益混合几何及辅助训练；RxR仅几何成功56.3%，高于完整模型。固定输入RTX4090延迟503.2升691.0毫秒。

papers.title: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Allocates matrix-level bitwidths using action sensitivity and a measured weight-recovery cost proxy; per-channel calibration and grouped lossless coding reduce storage while weights are recovered to BF16 block by block. One model, simulation only; 150 episodes per suite and timing over ten inputs excludes preprocessing/postprocessing. Baselines are literature reports; the official repository clarifies its 96.9% reference is FP16 despite the paper’s BF16 label. W1.5* means W4 vision plus average-W1.5 language, not a 1.5-bit complete model. Compression increases latency.
papers.summary_zh: 利用动作敏感度与权重恢复成本代理分配矩阵位宽；逐通道校准及分组无损编码降存储，执行时逐块恢复BF16权重。 仅单模型仿真，每套件150回合；10个输入计时不含前后处理。基线来自文献，官方仓库说明96.9%参照实际是FP16，尽管论文标BF16。W1.5*为视觉W4加语言平均W1.5，并非整模1.5bit；压缩增加延迟。

papers.title: Tiny Recursive Policy: Recursive Latent Refinement for Visuomotor Control
papers.summary_en: A small behavior-cloning policy repeatedly refines two shared latent states within each prediction and carries them between control steps; training detaches temporal gradients. Simulation only; LIBERO-Mem reports subgoal completion, not binary task success. Parameters count only the backbone and do not measure inference cost: the default uses three high-level cycles and six low-level refinements. Perturbation training improves robustness but lowers clean Mem score to 0.480.
papers.summary_zh: 小型行为克隆策略在单次预测内递归修订两层共享潜状态，并跨控制步保留状态；训练时截断跨步梯度。 仅仿真；LIBERO-Mem指标是子目标完成分而非整任务成功率。参数仅计骨干，不能代表推理成本：默认三次高层循环、六次低层修订。扰动训练增强鲁棒性，但干净Mem分数降至0.480。

papers.title: Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neurons for Event-Driven Vision-Language-Action Inference
papers.summary_en: Replaces selected π0.5 projections with signed power-of-two spiking events and residual membrane state; Heartbeat confines event extraction to each projection while preserving external token/cache interfaces. No measured hardware energy or latency. The 86.95% saving is an illustrative FP32 projection-arithmetic model excluding memory, control and encoding; a matched FP8 model with fixed movement budget estimates only 32.79% subtotal saving at T=1. Evaluation uses one seed and simulation; nonsignificance does not establish equivalence.
papers.summary_zh: 将π0.5部分投影替换为有符号二次幂脉冲及残余膜状态；Heartbeat把事件提取限制在各投影内部，保持外部token/缓存接口。 未测硬件能耗或延迟。86.95%节能是排除存储、控制和编码的示例FP32投影算术模型；匹配FP8且固定搬运预算时，T=1部分能耗估计仅省32.79%。评估单种子且仅仿真；不显著不等于统计等价。

papers.title: EXE: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Pretraining via Factorized Latent Actions for VLA Models
papers.summary_en: Factorizes human/robot actions into shared position codes and embodiment-specific kinematics, then co-trains a VLM on shared tokens before robot-action fine-tuning. Adds 50k tokenizer and 30k co-training steps on eight A800s; the baseline omits these stages, so compute is not matched. Real evaluation uses 2,450 demonstrations and only 10 trials per condition. The ablation section inconsistently calls a 73.2% row the same baseline reported as 66.8% in the main table.
papers.summary_zh: 将人类/机器人动作拆为共享位置码与形态专属运动学，再以共享token共训VLM并微调机器人动作。 额外使用8张A800进行50k步tokenizer训练与30k步共训；基线省去这些阶段，并非等算力。真机用2,450条示范、每条件仅10次试验。消融把73.2%一行称作基线，与主表66.8%不一致。

papers.title: POD-RoPE: Rotary Position Encoding over Physical Observation Distributions for Embodied AI
papers.summary_en: Encodes each token’s camera-center, ray-direction and time footprint as a distribution; expected rotations affect attention Q/K matching and coherence-aware V/O aggregation without expanding sequence length. Real evaluation has only 20 trials per task and uses 1, 694 training trajectories, 64 H20 GPUs and the 20 k-step checkpoint. Geometry depends on camera calibration/kinematics; block timing is not robot end-to-end latency, and visual geometry gains are not uniform across tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 把token覆盖的相机中心、射线方向与时间表示为分布；期望旋转用于Q/K匹配及相干性引导的V/O聚合，不增加序列长度。 真机每任务仅20次试验，训练使用1,694条轨迹、64张H20及20k步检查点。几何依赖相机标定/运动学；模块计时并非机器人端到端延迟，视觉几何任务收益也非一致。

papers.title: Late Breaking Results: Audio-Language-Action Models with Direct Speech Conditioning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Speech-π0.5 pools a frozen speech encoder into 32 VLM tokens and uses separate audio/task LoRA adapters, with speech–text distillation followed by action training. Two-page DAC late-breaking report; simulation and synthetic voices only, 500 episodes per suite/condition. The 3× latency gain trades off lower success than ASR, and timing does not separately account for speech capture or encoder cost. Training uses 100k synthesized instructions; compute/multi-seed details are limited.
papers.summary_zh: Speech-π0.5将冻结语音编码器输出池化为32个VLM tokens，分别使用音频/任务LoRA，先做语音–文本蒸馏再训练动作。 两页DAC late-breaking短文，仅仿真及合成声音，每套件/条件500回合。三倍首动作加速伴随低于ASR的成功率，计时未单独交代语音采集及编码器成本。训练含10万合成指令，算力/多种子细节有限。

papers.title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
papers.summary_en: Trains OFT-, GR00T- and π-style humanoid policies on 2,087 hours of human/simulated/robot data, predicting SONIC whole-body motion tokens plus hand signals; simulation supplies pseudo-proprioception and rendering replaces human arms during adaptation. One real task, fixed pretrained whole-body controller and full-parameter downstream tuning. Visual adaptation adds only two successful trials; pseudo-proprioception hurts OFT because its text state is truncated. Reported stages 1–2 take about 38+12 hours on eight GPUs; gains do not isolate additional data from pretraining compute.
papers.summary_zh: 以2,087小时人类、仿真及机器人数据训练OFT、GR00T和π式人形策略，输出SONIC全身运动token及手部信号；用仿真补伪本体状态、渲染替换人臂以适配。 仅一项真机任务，固定预训练全身控制器并全参数下游微调。视觉适配仅增加2次成功；伪本体状态因文本截断反而损害OFT。报告前两阶段8张GPU约38+12小时，收益未分离额外数据与预训练算力。

papers.title: Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: CogMemory adds a 3.45M-parameter history module: a selective state-space encoder, multi-slot temporal aggregation and variational compression, followed by gated cross-attention retrieval into two VLA fusion architectures. Simulation only and appendix specifies one seed (42), without multi-seed uncertainty. Policies and memory are optimized end-to-end for 30k steps on eight L20X GPUs, not an inference-only memory add-on. Best validation checkpoints are selected every 1k steps. Claimed 21.2→12.9s efficiency is task execution time on jointly successful cases, not measured model latency.
papers.summary_zh: CogMemory加入3.45M参数历史模块：选择性状态空间编码、多槽时间聚合与变分压缩，再通过门控交叉注意力接入两种VLA融合架构。 仅仿真，附录给单种子42，无多种子不确定性。策略与记忆在8张L20X上端到端训练30k步，并非仅推理时加记忆；每1k步验证选最好checkpoint。21.2→12.9秒是两方法共同成功样本的任务执行时间，不是模型推理延迟。

papers.title: AdaPolicy: Action-Driven Anticipatory Robot Policies via Next-Chunk Prediction
papers.summary_en: Adds a training-only EMA action head that predicts the next action chunk from an evolved latent state; its loss backpropagates through that state into the online policy, without future-image supervision. Real precision tasks use 1, 000/400 demonstrations, with human takeover corrections comprising 20% of each dataset; both methods use the same combined data. These are supervised anticipatory features, not evidence of autonomous online world-model adaptation; zero inference overhead is relative to the matched architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 增加仅训练使用的EMA动作头，依据演化潜状态预测下一动作块；损失经潜状态回传在线策略，不依赖未来图像监督。 真机精细任务各用1,000/400条示范，其中人工接管纠正占20%，双方使用同一混合数据。结果属于监督学习的前瞻特征，不证明自主在线世界模型适配；零推理开销是相对匹配架构而言。

papers.title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
papers.summary_en: RynnLAM extracts continuous latent actions using residual visual prediction, camera-compensated 3D flow and camera-motion decoupling; a flow-matching VLA learns from 30.1K video hours before native-action adaptation. Full-scale comparisons do not match pretraining data/compute; scaling does not isolate optimization exposure. Geometry is pseudo-labeled, not proof of metric or causal action identification. Real adaptation uses 3,850 demos. Main RoboTwin table/abstract say 88.6%, while the conclusion says 88.3%; no inference-speed benchmark is provided.
papers.summary_zh: RynnLAM以残差视觉预测、相机补偿3D流及相机运动解耦提取连续潜动作；流匹配VLA先用30.1K小时视频学习，再适配原生动作。 全规模比较不匹配预训练数据/算力，规模实验未隔离优化曝光量。几何为伪标签，并非度量或因果动作识别证据。真机适配用3,850条示范。RoboTwin主表/摘要88.6%，结论88.3%，存在不一致；未测推理速度。

papers.title: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation via Action Representation Pretraining
papers.summary_en: ARPG pretrains action representations against visual features on human manipulation data, freezes the encoder, and trains a 130M generative backbone plus decoder in that representation space. DexJoCo baselines are taken from its original paper; real evaluation has three tasks and 30 trials each. Same robot demos do not imply matched optimization: π0.5 uses 25k-step mixed LoRA, while ARPG has separate encoder/decoder training and up to 120k downstream steps. Hours sum clip durations, potentially counting overlaps; open-world semantics and gripper transfer remain untested.
papers.summary_zh: ARPG以人类操作数据让动作表示对齐视觉特征，冻结编码器，再在该空间训练130M生成骨干与解码器。 DexJoCo基线沿用原论文；真机仅3项任务、每项30次。同机器人示范不等于等优化预算：π0.5为25k步混合LoRA，ARPG另训编码器/解码器且下游最多120k步。小时数累计片段长度，可能计入重叠；开放语义与夹爪迁移未验证。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning
papers.summary_en: A training-free token allocator recomputes a fixed budget, reuses low-drift young KV caches and prunes invalid leftovers; drift thresholds are calibrated per backbone. Two OpenVLA-family backbones, simulation success tests and replay-stream hardware timings; no real-robot closed-loop test. Thresholds are empirically tuned; selected SimplerEnv tasks exclude floor-level full-recompute performance. The 48% headline reduction is prefill, not total control latency.
papers.summary_zh: 免训练token分配器固定重算预算、复用低漂移且较新的KV缓存，并剪除其余无效token；漂移阈值按骨干校准。 仅两个OpenVLA系列骨干、仿真成功率及回放流硬件计时，无真机闭环评估。阈值经验调参，SimplerEnv只保留完整重算明显高于地板的任务。48%降幅指预填充，不是整体控制延迟。

papers.title: VLA-HWBench: Where the Time Goes When VLA Models Run on Edge Hardware
papers.summary_en: Profiles 18 released VLA models, 19 configurations and seven inference stages on Jetson AGX Thor and AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395, separating action generation, backends and host preprocessing. Timing is not a closed-loop success benchmark: inputs are a shared LIBERO observation plus 24 frames from one episode, with 20–100 timed calls. Models retain different native chunk/execution settings. Compilation can change gripper commands; low-bit action similarity does not establish preserved task success.
papers.summary_zh: 在Jetson AGX Thor及AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上剖析18个公开VLA、19种配置和七阶段推理，分离动作生成、后端及CPU预处理成本。 计时并非闭环成功率基准：共享LIBERO观测及单回合24帧，每配置20–100次计时。模型保留各自chunk/执行配置。编译可改变夹爪命令；低位宽动作相似度不等于任务成功率保持。

papers.title: JevVLA: Jev-Inspired Energy-Based Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary_en: Freezes the base policy and learns a 79, 817-parameter conditional energy; values rank discrete proposals and action gradients refine continuous outputs. Each benchmark trains separate adapter weights and encodings. Simulation only; no matched LoRA comparison. Reported counts are rounded averages over five seeds, not raw independent trial counts. Gains require feedback/expert-derived supervision and benchmark-specific validation; the compact adapter excludes frozen-policy inference and rollout costs.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结基础策略，学习79,817参数条件能量；能量值排序离散候选，动作梯度修正连续输出。各基准独立训练适配器权重及编码。 仅仿真，无匹配LoRA对照。成功次数是五种子均值取整，并非原始独立试验计数。增益依赖反馈/专家监督与逐基准验证；小适配器参数不含冻结策略推理及rollout成本。

papers.title: Robot-Aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Precise Reaching with Wrist-Camera VLA Policies
papers.summary_en: Builds a robot-aligned 3 D Gaussian scene from wrist-camera captures, renders feasible smooth reaching trajectories, and fine-tunes a VLA with an instruction-conditioned proximity verifier for termination. Ten times more synthetic trajectories; under 10 min active capture still entails about 200 min total, comparable to 150-demo teleoperation. Only pre-contact reaching is learned; precision is validated by a fixed downstream grasp routine. Three targets, 25 trials each and moderate motherboard repositioning do not establish arbitrary layout or contact-task generalization.
papers.summary_zh: 从腕部相机采集重建机器人对齐3D高斯场景，渲染可行平滑接近轨迹，微调VLA并以指令条件距离验证器判断停止。 生成轨迹数量为对照十倍；主动采集不足10分钟，但总耗时约200分钟，与150条遥操相当。只学习接触前接近，精度由固定后续抓取例程验证。三目标各25次及中等主板位移不能证明任意布局或接触任务泛化。

papers.title: Preemptive Instruction Following with Resumption
papers.summary_en: Introduces navigation episodes with single, repeated and nested task interruptions; a candidate-ranking objective emphasizes re-grounding when a suspended task resumes. Interruptions occur after completion of the current atomic task. Simulation navigation, not manipulation or VLA motor control. Reported SR averages atomic navigation segments, not whole interrupted sequence completion; improvements vary by interruption setting. Resume weighting helps stage metrics but does not dominate simpler BCE on aggregate SR.
papers.summary_zh: 构建单次、重复及嵌套任务打断的导航回合，以候选排序目标加强恢复暂停任务时的重新落地；打断发生在当前原子任务完成后。 仅仿真导航，非操作或VLA运动控制。所报SR平均原子导航片段，并非整个被打断序列完成率；各打断设置增益不同。恢复加权改善阶段指标，但整体SR不优于更简单BCE。

papers.title: WorldFailBench: Do World Models Understand Policy Failures?
papers.summary_en: Evaluates whether world models reproduce policy failure reasons, stages and success-to-failure boundaries, rather than only final outcomes. Real-robot coverage is two tasks; boundary interventions are simulation-only. Boundary discovery selects adjacent conditions with a ≥30-point success gap, then independently re-estimates endpoints; this is not an unbiased estimate over all scene changes.
papers.summary_zh: 从失败原因、发生阶段及成功转失败边界评估世界模型，而非只看最终成败。 真机仅2项任务，边界扰动仅在仿真进行。边界先按相邻条件≥30个百分点差距筛选，再独立重估端点；不能视作全部场景变化的无偏统计。

papers.title: RoboWorM: Evaluating Movement Realism, Consistency and Acceleration Affects in Embodied Video World Models
papers.summary_en: Introduces hardware-prior-based KIVA kinematic stability and RIGIS multi-view geometry metrics, plus a world-model acceleration audit. Measures generated-video consistency, not downstream control success. Metrics do not establish contact physics, deformable behavior or force dynamics; some long-horizon comparisons confound rollout depth and non-Markovian regime.
papers.summary_zh: 提出依赖机器人硬件先验的KIVA运动学稳定性与RIGIS多视角几何指标，并审计世界模型加速代价。 测量生成视频一致性而非下游控制成功；不验证接触物理、形变或力学。部分长时域比较混合了轨迹长度与非马尔可夫设置。

papers.title: Behavior Spatial Benchmark: Evaluating Spatial Understanding for Robotics
papers.summary_en: Connects spatial VQA, target grounding and VLA execution while separating target-selection intention from strict task completion. Entirely simulated. Headline abstract rates are soft intention measures, not task completion. Oracle grounding is privileged; task timeouts and hand-target correlations affect interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: 连接空间问答、目标定位与VLA执行，并区分选对目标意图与严格任务完成。 完全仿真；摘要头条数字是软意图指标，不是任务完成率。理想定位属特权信息，超时预算及手臂—目标相关性影响解释。

papers.title: X-World: Transferring Video Priors to Variable-View Robot Control
papers.summary_en: Transfers a video backbone to variable-view control with residual cross-view attention, a layer-aligned Q-Former and shared action expert with native dataset interfaces. Reference baselines do not match pretraining data/compute. Camera, background and noise shifts remain weaker than OpenVLA-OFT; LIBERO-Plus weighting is unspecified. One physical platform, no demonstrated unseen-embodiment transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 通过残差跨视角注意力、层对齐Q-Former及共享动作专家，将视频骨干迁移到可变视角控制；保留各数据集原生接口。 对比基线预训练数据/算力不匹配；相机、背景、噪声扰动弱于OpenVLA-OFT，LIBERO-Plus汇总权重未说明。只有一种真机平台，未证明未见形态迁移。

papers.title: AuRA: From Atoms to Bits through Autonomous Robot Interaction
papers.summary_en: Automates deformable digital-twin acquisition with feasible grasp selection, robot-state-derived gripper trajectories and registered pre-interaction geometry/appearance. Collection accounting excludes processing/reconstruction and untimed backup trials; expert collection is faster (100.6s) than AuRA. Prediction uses known gripper motion; unseen tests use selected assets and manual alignment. No policy-learning gain demonstrated.
papers.summary_zh: 以可执行抓取筛选、机器人状态导出的夹爪轨迹及交互前几何/外观先验自动采集可形变数字孪生。 采集成本不含处理、重建及未计时补充试验；专家采集100.6秒，快于AuRA。预测使用已知夹爪运动；未见交互测试挑选资产且人工对齐。未展示策略学习增益。

papers.title: What Does World Modeling Actually Improve in Robot Action Learning?
papers.summary_en: Controlled future-video-loss removal within FastWAM and OpenWAM tests what predictive supervision changes; a training-only lightweight video predictor extends the test to π0.5. Simulation-only; gains under unseen tasks are inconsistent and environmental randomization leaves low success without a consistent prediction-loss advantage. Single training seed; rollout repeats do not establish training-seed robustness. Wan extension changes multiple factors.
papers.summary_zh: 在FastWAM和OpenWAM内控制架构、初始化、数据和步数，仅移除未来视频损失；再用训练期轻量预测器扩展到π0.5。 仅仿真；未见任务增益不一致，环境随机化下成功率低且预测损失无稳定优势。单训练种子，轨迹重复不代表训练随机性稳健；Wan扩展同时改变多项因素。

papers.title: Video World Models Need Predictable Latents
papers.summary_en: Fine-tunes autoencoder latents for temporal predictability and uses a past-conditioned decoder to preserve reconstruction while simplifying world-model dynamics. Main evidence concerns video prediction and policy-evaluation agreement, not improved robot policy success. Studies 2D spatial autoencoders fine-tuned from pretrained models; broader domains and spatiotemporal autoencoders are untested.
papers.summary_zh: 用时间可预测性目标微调自编码潜变量，并以历史条件解码器保留重建信息、简化世界模型动力学。 主证据是视频预测与策略评估一致性，不是机器人策略成功率提高。研究限于预训练2D空间自编码器微调，更广领域与时空自编码器尚未验证。

papers.title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
papers.summary_en: OpTTA adapts a latent world model with observed-transition prediction loss plus an optimistic goal-reaching cost on planner candidate rollouts, without extra interactions. Simulated pushing, reaching and navigation only; adaptation resets per task and uses at most 30 replans. LeWM TwoRoom can degrade. This is parameter adaptation for planning, not an established continual or real-robot capability.
papers.summary_zh: OpTTA以已观测转移预测损失加规划候选轨迹的乐观到达目标代价适配潜在世界模型，不增加交互。 仅模拟推物、到达和导航；每任务重置适配、最多30次重规划。LeWM TwoRoom可能下降。是面向规划的参数适配，尚非持续学习或真机能力证据。

papers.title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
papers.summary_en: Uses action/scene imagination tokens for structured diffusion initialization and privileged future-conditioned distillation to generate actions in one denoising step. One-step is a speed/quality trade-off, not uniform superiority. Real tests are small; completion time is video-estimated on successes only. H20 and compiled RTX5090 latency numbers use different setups; NAVSIM is not real-road deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 利用动作/场景想象token提供结构化扩散初值，并蒸馏带未来条件的特权信息，实现一步动作去噪。 一步是速度/质量取舍，并非全面优越。真机样本小，完成时间只对成功轨迹从视频估计。H20与编译RTX5090延迟设置不同；NAVSIM不是真实道路部署。

papers.title: SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments
papers.summary_en: An agentic pipeline reconstructs interactive simulators from 3D/4D captures, inspects and repairs scenes, and produces digital-sister variants and scripted demonstrations. Geometry/IoU improvements are not calibrated contact dynamics. Physical parameters are unmeasured estimates; static evaluation uses very few scenes and single conversions. Real transfer is preliminary and non-monotonic with simulated data scale.
papers.summary_zh: 代理流程从3D/4D采集重建可交互仿真，通过检查修复场景，并生成相似变体与脚本示范。 几何/IoU提升不是经校准的接触动力学；物理参数未测量验证，静态评估场景少且单次转换。真机迁移初步，仿真数据规模增长不保证收益。

papers.title: Behavioural Quality Is Not Learning Utility: Objective Mismatch in Human Behaviour Models for Robot Learning
papers.summary_en: Tests whether human-behavior generative metrics predict their usefulness as simulated training partners for robot RL. Policy tests are simulated, including simulated human partners—not physical human-robot trials. Findings depend on these model families, representations and RL training protocols; they do not imply realistic behavior is unnecessary for safety.
papers.summary_zh: 检验人类行为模型的生成评测指标能否预测其作为机器人RL训练伙伴的效用。 策略测试在仿真人类伙伴下进行，不是真人人机试验。结论受模型族、表示及RL训练流程限制，不表示真实行为对安全不重要。

papers.title: EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins
papers.summary_en: Maps documented safety hazards to eight executable fault operators, verifies realized interventions and separately records safety violations and task outcomes. Simulation only; safety is limited to simulator-state predicates. Challenge exposure is close to Random-Legal and Rule-Based, not a blanket superiority result; unsafe-success counts diagnose metric mismatch rather than rank methods.
papers.summary_zh: 把文献安全危害映射为8个可执行故障算子，验证干预确实发生，并分开记录安全违规与任务结果。 仅仿真，安全限于仿真状态可定义谓词。挑战暴露率接近Random-Legal及Rule-Based，并非全面优越；不安全成功数量用于诊断指标错配而非方法排名。

papers.title: TurboWAM: Learning What Matters for Fast World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Selectively aggregates early world-model layers conditioned on noisy actions and modulates action gradients during training, retaining video co-training without test-time video generation. Benchmarks have unmatched embodied pretraining across methods. Prompt-corrected results must not be conflated with the original protocol. Layer structure is architectural, not explicit 3D geometry; latency alone does not establish safe control. GPU model is unspecified (approximately 140GB data-center GPU). Physical-robot experiments are referred to supplementary material; their quantitative results were not established in the checked text.
papers.summary_zh: 按带噪动作聚合世界模型前层表示，并在训练时调节动作梯度；保留视频联合训练而推理不生成未来视频。 各方法具身预训练不匹配；修正提示结果不可与原协议混为一谈。层结构指架构而非显式3D几何，延迟不等于安全控制。 GPU仅描述为约140GB数据中心卡、未指明型号。文中将真机实验指向补充材料，所核正文未建立其定量结果。

papers.title: WMEval: Evaluating Interactive World Models Grounded on Physical Simulations
papers.summary_en: WMEval v2 expands uncertainty reporting and clarifies causal effects relative to a Unity reference and the treatment of divergent initial conditions.
papers.summary_zh: WMEval v2 扩展不确定性报告，并澄清相对 Unity 参考的因果效应及初始条件偏离样本处理。

papers.title: Mix Forcing: Causal Pre-Training via Mixture Attention for Interactive World Models
papers.summary_en: Mix Forcing jointly trains teacher-forced causal and bidirectional video objectives with chunk-local prompt attention, then distills a four-step autoregressive generator. Camera/text-conditioned video generation only: no action-policy success, physical fidelity or robot transfer test. Public global-prompt benchmarks mismatch its local-prompt training; 14B training uses substantial compute.
papers.summary_zh: Mix Forcing联合教师强制因果与双向视频训练，并用分块局部提示注意力，再蒸馏为4步自回归生成器。 仅相机/文本条件视频生成：未测动作策略成功、物理保真或机器人迁移。公开全局提示基准与局部提示训练不匹配，14B训练算力大。

papers.title: One Scan is Enough: Demonstration-Free Adaptation for Language-Guided Navigation
papers.summary_en: Converts one phone scan per building into a Gaussian-splat navigation environment and grounded instruction episodes; known-scene Pareto utilities guide policy post-training without human demonstrations or a learned critic. Demonstration-free is not human-free: scanning and evaluation-instruction checking require people. Baselines have different scene-specific data budgets; unscanned means same buildings, not unseen buildings. Real success uses a 1.5m radius, and changed layouts require rescanning. This is offline scene post-training, not online per-step TTT.
papers.summary_zh: 将每栋建筑的一次手机扫描转换为高斯场景及指令导航样本，再以已知场景的Pareto效用进行策略后训练，无需人类示范或学习型critic。 无示范不等于无人介入：扫描和评估指令核对仍需人工。基线场景数据预算不同；未扫描区域仍属同建筑，而非未见建筑。真机成功半径1.5米，布局显著变化需重扫。属于场景后训练，非逐步在线TTT。

papers.title: HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
papers.summary_en: Learns a history-based proprioceptive neural dynamics model with forward-kinematics supervision, then fine-tunes humanoid tracking policies through model gradients; low-frequency reference perturbations collect deployment-viable data. Small physical repetition counts and task-specific tracking/completion metrics, not broad manipulation success. Real-world baselines are direct transfer and disturbance-aware PPO where feasible, not the full simulation baseline set. Authors limit the method to time-invariant disturbance settings; collection/training precede adapted deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 以历史本体状态及正运动学监督学习神经动力学，再通过模型梯度微调人形跟踪策略；低频参考扰动用于可部署数据采集。 真机重复次数少，使用任务专属跟踪/完成指标，而非广泛操作成功率。真机基线为直接迁移和可建模情况下的扰动PPO，不包含全部仿真对照。作者将适用范围限为时不变扰动设置；需先采集和训练再部署适配策略。

papers.title: Replicate What Varies: Resource Sharing for Domain-Randomized Embodied Simulation
papers.summary_en: Patchwork represents environments as shared templates plus private mutation patches, sharing compiled MuJoCo structure and immutable assets while isolating state and randomized parameters. Infrastructure/resource results, not improved policy learning. Main headline excludes camera/object observation processing; camera path has Python GIL bottlenecks. Reuse diminishes with template/asset diversity, mutations are backend-restricted, and comparison with asynchronous GPU-vectorized execution remains future work.
papers.summary_zh: Patchwork将环境表示为共享模板加私有变更补丁，共享编译MuJoCo结构和不可变资产，隔离状态与随机化参数。 是基础设施/资源结果，不是策略学习增益。主头条关闭相机/物体观测处理；相机路径存在Python GIL瓶颈。模板/资产多样性越高共享越少，变更受后端限制，与异步GPU向量执行的比较待完成。

papers.title: SPECOLA: A Tool for Specification Driven Robot Evaluation
papers.summary_en: Specola exposes simulator signals to Signal Temporal Logic monitors, measuring satisfaction margins and persistence alongside task success; provides APIs and adapters for nine simulators/benchmarks. Privileged simulator state and user-written predicates define the conclusions; results do not certify physical safety. Fixed-period monitoring does not yet handle asynchronous, uncertain real sensors. A stricter persistence requirement changes evaluation semantics, not the original benchmark score.
papers.summary_zh: Specola把仿真信号接入信号时序逻辑监视器，除成功率外测满足余量及持续性，并提供API及9种仿真/基准适配器。 结论依赖特权仿真状态及人工规格，不构成真机安全认证。固定周期监视尚不处理异步、不确定真实传感器。更严格的持续要求改变评测语义，并不改写原基准分数。

papers.title: MDPO: Multi-constraint Dexterous Policy Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: Separately projects cumulative and state-wise constraints in reinforcement learning for dexterous manipulation. Hardware evidence is qualitative, not a quantified real-world safety guarantee; constraint-estimation assumptions still matter.
papers.summary_zh: 将累计约束和逐状态约束分别投影，用于灵巧操作强化学习。 真机证据主要为定性展示，不等于定量验证真实安全保证；约束估计假设仍重要。

papers.title: RBGA: Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration for Offline-to-Online Safe Reinforcement Learning in Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Arbitrates offline guidance and online exploration using estimated cost-to-go and remaining within-episode safety budget. The experiments replace binary costs with continuous costs. Bounds depend on estimator assumptions; hardware lacks a quantitative trial table.
papers.summary_zh: 依据剩余回合安全预算与代价到达估计，在离线引导和在线探索之间仲裁。 实验将二值代价改为连续代价；理论界依赖估计假设，硬件部分没有定量试验表。

papers.title: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
papers.summary_en: Adds reinforcement-learned reference, object-latent and target modulation around a distilled dexterous tracker. Completion is the average fraction of frames satisfying tracking-error thresholds, not binary whole-task success. Explicit object poses/meshes and reliable pose estimation are required; symmetric objects are challenging.
papers.summary_zh: 在蒸馏灵巧跟踪器外增加强化学习的参考、物体隐变量与目标调制。 Completion是各轨迹满足跟踪误差阈值的帧比例再取平均，并非整任务二元成功率。依赖显式物体姿态、网格与可靠姿态估计，对称物体仍有挑战。

papers.title: RoboLongR: Causally Consistent Rewards Teach Robots to Progressively Master Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Learns history-sensitive rewards with recurrent memory, shuffled-stage negatives and terminal correction, then fine-tunes a behavioral-cloning policy with RL. Only 10 real trials per task. Removing memory, stage shuffling or correction yields 28.9%, 24.3% or 28.4%. Online correction is used by RoboLongR and Progress+Mono, but not ReWiND or other baselines; the main comparison tests complete pipelines.
papers.summary_zh: 以循环记忆、阶段打乱负样本和终止纠正学习历史敏感奖励，再通过RL微调行为克隆策略。 真机每任务仅10次。去记忆、阶段打乱或纠正后分别为28.9%、24.3%、28.4%。在线纠正仅用于RoboLongR与Progress+Mono，不用于ReWiND等基线；主对比评估完整流程。

papers.title: PS-DLO: Property- and Spatially Aware Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Policy
papers.summary_en: Conditions deformable-linear-object policies on textual physical-property priors and distills future visual features into an action expert. Separate policies are trained for different embodiments. Future observations are used in training, not an online predictive world-model interface.
papers.summary_zh: 以文本物性先验调节柔性线状物操作策略，并向动作专家蒸馏未来视觉特征。 不同本体分别训练策略；未来观察用于训练，不是部署时在线预测世界模型接口。

papers.title: Zero-HLM: Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation without Real Robot Data
papers.summary_en: Uses smartphone scene reconstruction, agentic simulation construction and motion/environment co-adaptation to generate humanoid manipulation data without real robot demonstrations. The headline 20-point advantage compares unequal demonstration counts. Broader coverage also changes training distribution; it is not a matched-data improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 通过手机场景重建、Agent仿真构建及运动/环境协同适配，生成无需真实机器人示范的人形操作数据。 主打的20个百分点优势比较了不等量示范；扩展覆盖还改变训练分布，不能解释为等数据提升。

papers.title: Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Collects robot-free force-aware demonstrations and combines a diffusion pose/force policy with hybrid-compliance whole-body control. Small task/trial coverage and force-sensing hardware requirements limit generality; the ablations do not establish unrestricted contact-skill transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 采集无需机器人参与的力感知示范，将扩散位姿/力策略与混合柔顺全身控制结合。 任务及试次数较少，并依赖力传感硬件；消融不能证明任意接触技能迁移。

papers.title: HA-DiPO: Diffusion Policy Optimization for Heterogeneous Cooperative Transport
papers.summary_en: Trains a hierarchical multi-agent diffusion policy for cooperative payload transport with centralized training and decentralized execution. The 93.5% figure is simulation, not real-robot success. Best-checkpoint selection and a narrowly defined transport controller constrain interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: 以集中训练、分散执行训练分层多智能体扩散策略，实现协同载荷运输。 93.5%来自仿真而非真机成功率；最佳检查点选择与特定运输控制器限制结论范围。

papers.title: Open-World Law-to-Action: Vision-Language Priors and Touch for Parts with Hidden Physics
papers.summary_en: Combines vision-language physical-law priors, Bayesian touch-based identification and requests for additional views when observations remain ambiguous. No hardware robot validation. One embodied protocol was changed between held-out tests, so its comparison should not be treated as a clean confirmatory result.
papers.summary_zh: 结合视觉语言物理规律先验、触觉贝叶斯辨识，以及观察歧义时请求新视角。 没有硬件机器人验证；一个具身协议在两次留出测试之间修改，不应视为干净的验证性对照。

papers.title: EKT-Router: Expert-Evidence Alignment for Embodied Vision-Language Models
papers.summary_en: EKT-Router jointly selects one of three frozen Qwen3-VL-8B capability experts, optional knowledge and perceptual tools under a call budget; a verifier filters returned evidence before a single final answer with original-input fallback. Embodied QA, not robot execution or active perception. Three experts require separate two-epoch adaptations; routing uses 1,020 fitting and 180 held-out media-disjoint cases. Cross-system scores mix reproduced, API and reported results. Single-round packet validity does not prove answer correctness, action safety or stable online learning.
papers.summary_zh: EKT-Router在调用预算内联合选择三个冻结Qwen3-VL-8B能力专家之一、可选知识及感知工具；验证器筛选证据后只回答一次，必要时退回原始输入。 是具身问答而非机器人执行/主动感知。3专家分别适配2轮；路由使用1,020拟合及180媒体隔离留出样本。跨系统分数混合复现、API和引用结果。单轮证据有效性不证明答案正确、动作安全或在线学习稳定。

papers.title: World-in-Context: Interactive Video World Modeling with In-Context Conditioning
papers.summary_en: World-in-Context places view, character-action and camera controls in shared self-attention as explicit tokens; Interaction-Transport RoPE incorporates accumulated control transitions into temporal attention. Navigation score is a composite video metric, not robot task success. Main model uses bidirectional fine-tuning on 100k navigation clips plus 500 switching sequences; the final 93.8% result is not single-view-only training. Cross-system data/compute are not matched; controlled architecture comparisons share its data. No embodied manipulation or physical-control validation.
papers.summary_zh: World-in-Context将视角、角色动作及相机控制作为显式token放入共享自注意力；Interaction-Transport RoPE将累积控制变化纳入时间注意力。 导航分是视频综合指标，不是机器人任务成功率。主模型以100k导航片段加500条切换序列双向微调，最终93.8%并非仅单视角训练。跨系统未匹配数据/算力，架构控制实验使用同数据。未验证实体操作或物理控制。

papers.title: Distilling Dense Trajectory Teachers For Large-Motion Video World Models
papers.summary_en: DTTD interpolates sparse camera paths, uses the frozen base model’s dense-path videos as pose-aligned teachers, and combines teacher/geometry rewards to form offline Flow-DPO preferences with a cumulative motion curriculum. One camera-conditioned Wan1.3B backbone and one indoor dataset; no robot planning/control outcomes. Uses 10k preference pairs, 12 student candidates and four teacher videos per condition, each generated with 40 denoising steps; matching optimizer steps does not establish equal data-generation compute. Geometry rewards rely on estimated depth/poses; DTTD is not best on every geometric metric.
papers.summary_zh: DTTD插值稀疏相机路径，以冻结基础模型在密集路径生成的视频作位姿对齐教师，再结合教师/几何奖励构建离线Flow-DPO偏好及累进运动课程。 仅相机条件Wan1.3B骨干与单室内数据集，无机器人规划/控制结果。10k偏好对、每条件12个学生候选和4个教师视频，各40去噪步；等优化步不等于等数据生成算力。几何奖励依赖估计深度/位姿，也并非所有几何指标最优。

papers.title: Memory or a Clock? Auditing a Memory Advantage in XLand-MiniGrid with Seeds, Maps and Evaluation Noise Apart
papers.summary_en: Audits recurrent-policy gains by separating training-seed, map and evaluation noise, then adding size-matched memory-free clock controls and recurrent-state resets. One 7×7-grid task, A2C and tiny networks; not a VLA or robot experiment. The 15pp preregistered advantage threshold fails despite a nonzero residual gap. Some no-clock and mechanism arms were added after interim/results inspection, and no time-independent reward control was run.
papers.summary_zh: 分离训练种子、地图和评估噪声，再以参数匹配的无记忆时钟基线及循环状态清零，审计循环策略的优势来源。 仅一个7×7网格任务、A2C及微小网络，非VLA或机器人实验。虽然残余差距非零，但未达到预先设定的15个百分点优势阈值。部分无时钟及机制实验在查看中期/最终结果后增加，未运行时间无关奖励对照。

papers.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: CLE organizes 120 professional workflows into five dependent levels each, with persistent files/service state and human-authored rubrics; it measures complete agents under one- versus two-submission budgets. No robot tasks. Backbone parameters and harness implementation remain fixed; mutable context/memory is allowed, so results do not demonstrate recursive code/weight self-improvement. Trial 1/2 change submission budget and feedback, not just learning. One fixed task order, heterogeneous default agent settings and gated progression confound a pure memory-transfer interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: CLE把120项专业流程组织成各五层依赖任务，保留文件/服务状态并使用人工规则；在一次或两次提交预算下评测完整代理。 无机器人任务。基座参数及harness实现固定，允许上下文/记忆变化，不证明递归代码/权重自改进。两trial改变提交预算和反馈，而非只改变学习。固定单一任务顺序、不同代理默认设置及闯关门槛，使结果不能纯归因于记忆迁移。

papers.title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
papers.summary_en: HaMo stores strategy cards extracted from expert trajectories, selects complementary anchors by retrieval coverage, and continually trains one LoRA adapter with experience-conditioned behavior cloning and historical replay. All environments are text-only; ScienceWorld/WebShop scores include partial credit, not binary success. Model-only ablation removes both harness memory and replay, confounding their contributions. Training uses three epochs per stage; optional memory deletion is disabled in every experiment. Within-domain stages introduce new samples, not new task types; multi-seed uncertainty is not established.
papers.summary_zh: HaMo从专家轨迹抽取策略卡，以检索覆盖选择互补训练锚点，并结合经验条件行为克隆与历史回放持续更新一个LoRA适配器。 全部为纯文本环境；ScienceWorld/WebShop有部分分数，非二元成功率。仅模型消融同时去除外部记忆及回放，混合两者贡献。每阶段训练三轮，所有实验均禁用可选记忆删除。同域阶段增加样本而非新任务类别，未建立多种子不确定性。

papers.title: PhysEvolve: Verifier-grounded Self-evolution for Physical Reasoning with Executable Worlds
papers.summary_en: A shared VLM proposes executable physical scenes and solves questions; a fixed simulator validates scenes, runs matched body-removal interventions and binds answers, rather than letting the proposer label its own tasks. Question answering, not robot control. One training run per configuration on four GPUs; uses 24 hand-provided demonstration programs. Branch ablation also removes task families and changes retained rollout count (8,668 versus 7,960), so it does not isolate branch execution under matched exposure. Broad transfer gains are small and uneven.
papers.summary_zh: 共享VLM提出可执行物理场景并解题；固定模拟器验证场景、运行配对物体移除干预并绑定答案，避免提议者自行标注任务。 仅问答而非机器人控制；各配置单次训练、四张GPU，并使用24个人工示范程序。分支消融同时去除任务族且改变保留rollout数（8,668对7,960），未在等曝光条件下隔离分支执行。广域迁移收益较小且不均。

papers.title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
papers.summary_en: WorldPager keeps int4 world-model KV across GPU, pinned DRAM and NVMe; it prefetches pose-predicted retrievals, reuses stale entries instead of waiting on misses, writes back asynchronously and remaps positions beyond the native horizon. “Zero stall” excludes dequantization/write-back and permits stale retrieval; it is not zero overhead or real-time 16fps. Timing uses one scene/seed and one physical drive; slower drives are software-emulated. Quality evidence is MG2-only, with three scenes/five seeds for long-gap tests; texture drift remains. Baselines are reimplementations, not original systems.
papers.summary_zh: WorldPager将int4世界模型KV分存GPU、锁页DRAM和NVMe；依据预测相机位姿预取，未命中使用旧条目而不等待，异步写回并在原生时域外重映射位置。 “零停顿”不含反量化/写回且允许旧检索，并非零开销或16fps实时。计时仅单场景/种子及单实体硬盘，慢盘以软件模拟。质量证据仅MG2，长间隔3场景/5种子；纹理漂移仍存在。基线为重实现，并非原系统。

papers.title: RoboEvolve: Co-Evolving Planner-Simulator for Robotic Manipulation with Limited Data
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds §5.5: the planner–simulator co-evolution loop is instantiated with action-capable LingBot-VA and LIBERO environment feedback. This is a new low-level-control extension, not a new version of the already reported generative-planning gains. The new extension uses external simulator feedback, unlike the internally supervised VLM–VGM setting. No physical deployment; 500 seeds do not represent the total supervision or interaction budget, and this section does not establish a complete interaction-cost match.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增§5.5：将规划器—模拟器共同演化循环接入可输出动作的LingBot-VA及LIBERO环境反馈。这是新增低层控制扩展，原有生成式规划收益并非本次新结果。 新增扩展依赖外部仿真反馈，不同于内部监督的VLM–VGM设置；未真机部署。500张种子不代表总监督量或交互预算，该节未建立完整交互成本匹配。

papers.title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds an eight-subtask Clean Table real-robot task, lighting-shift tests, capacity/predictive-interface controls, and training-cost/confidence-interval reporting. The 98.6% LIBERO and 187 ms headline results already appear in v1. Clean Table success remains modest, especially under lighting shift; comparisons use few real tasks. Mechanism controls omit Stage-2 pretraining and should not be equated with the fully pretrained policy. The lighting tests reuse color-augmented task checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增八子任务Clean Table真机任务、光照变化测试、容量/预测接口对照及训练成本/置信区间。98.6% LIBERO与187毫秒主结果在v1已存在。 Clean Table绝对成功率仍低，光照变化下尤甚；真机任务较少。机理对照均去掉第二阶段预训练，不能直接等同完整预训练策略；光照测试复用已做颜色增强的任务检查点。

papers.title: GE-Act 2.0: Pretraining and Scaling a World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 substantively replaces Appendix A.1/Table 3 RoboTwin evaluation: six named perturbation columns become Clean-to-Clean and Clean-to-Random under 50 clean demonstrations per task, with additional leaderboard baselines. This is a protocol/result replacement, not a directly comparable version-to-version gain. Baselines are drawn from the official RoboTwin leaderboard where available and the Qwen-RM report, rather than all being rerun in a controlled study. The main real-robot pretraining/scaling findings are inherited from v2.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3实质替换附录A.1/表3的RoboTwin评测：六类扰动列改为每任务50条clean示范下的Clean-to-Clean和Clean-to-Random，并扩充榜单基线。这是协议/结果替换，不能作为同条件版本提升。 基线尽可能引用RoboTwin官方榜单及Qwen-RM报告，并非统一受控重跑；主要真机预训练/扩展结果沿用v2。

papers.title: WorldArena 2.0: Extending Embodied World Model Benchmarking on Modality, Functionality and Platform
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds a physical tactile ablation, detailed RL/decoder interfaces, uncertainty reporting and expanded real-robot task documentation. The broad visuotactile/RL/cross-platform benchmark concept was already in v1. Small physical samples yield wide intervals; separate Wilson intervals are not a paired significance test. World-model utility includes separately trained decoders, so it is not isolated transition fidelity. Expanded qualitative tasks must not be counted as a new quantitative leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增真机触觉消融、详细RL/解码接口、统计不确定性和扩展真机任务文档；视触觉/RL/跨平台基准整体构想在v1已存在。 真机样本少、区间宽；各条件Wilson区间不是配对显著性检验。世界模型效用包含分别训练的解码器，不等于单独动力学精度；扩展定性任务不能算作新增定量榜单。

papers.title: UniManip: Open-World Robotic Manipulation via Agentic Operational Graphs
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds LIBERO-Pro evaluation and explicit cross-embodiment UR7e/Robotiq and dexterous-hand tests, alongside formalized bounded AOG recovery. The original 22.5/25.0-point advantages are inherited, not new revision gains. Cross-embodiment transfer retains task-level AOG but requires a new URDF/limits, tool-frame calibration, controller mapping and hardware-facing adaptation. Do not describe it as literally configuration-free; dexterous execution success is only 53%.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增LIBERO-Pro评测及明确的UR7e/Robotiq与灵巧手跨本体测试，并形式化有预算上限的AOG恢复。原22.5/25.0个百分点优势不是本次新增收益。 跨本体保留任务级AOG，但仍需替换URDF/关节限位、工具坐标标定、控制器映射及硬件接口适配，不能说完全零配置；灵巧手执行成功率仅53%。

papers.title: RoboGene: Diversity-Driven Agentic Task Generation Framework for VLA Pre-training
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 adds broader real-robot OOD evaluation and human-effort/memory analysis (Appendix H.2/H.4), rather than merely restating the existing task-generation architecture and 18k trajectories. This is not zero-shot task transfer: target-task fine-tuning remains. Labor is estimated using fixed per-task/per-correction durations, including teleoperation and human verification; declining correction rates alone do not isolate memory causality.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3新增更广泛真机OOD评测及人工成本/记忆分析（附录H.2/H.4），不只是重述原任务生成架构和1.8万轨迹。 不是零样本任务迁移，仍需目标任务微调。人工成本按固定单次耗时估算，包含遥操作与人工验证；纠错率下降本身不能单独证明记忆因果贡献。

papers.title: BEACON: Cross-Domain Co-Training of Generative Robot Policies via Best-Effort Adaptation
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 adds tuned-uniform and source-mean discrepancy controls, feature-alignment diagnostics and a weight audit that explicitly limits the theory claim. The main BEACON success values mostly predate this revision. The theoretical bound motivates the objective but is not an applicable guarantee for the audited learned weights. New feature alignment is diagnostic; lower discrepancy itself does not imply higher task success, as the MMD baseline demonstrates.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3新增调优统一权重、源均值差异对照、特征对齐诊断及明确约束理论结论的权重审计；主要BEACON成功率在旧版已有。 理论界用于启发目标函数，不能当作已审计学习权重的有效保证。新增对齐结果是诊断证据；MMD基线也表明差异更小不必然带来更高任务成功率。

papers.title: Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 adds Appendix J disjoint-source-group evaluations: backbones are trained from scratch on training-only groups and heads selected on separate groups. This directly probes overlap concerns in the released-asset benchmarks; original headline gains are not new. Push-T shows no improvement in this stronger separation test. New task windows differ from the original benchmark (uniform Cube starts; 80-step rather than 74-step Push-T gaps); do not compare absolute rates across protocols. SE covers backbone seeds, not sampled tasks/source groups. Simulation only.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3新增附录J按源状态分组、训练/选点/测试分离的评测：骨干仅在训练组从零训练，head在独立组选择，直接检验原发布资产基准的重叠顾虑；原主结果不是新贡献。 更严格分离下Push-T没有提升。新任务窗不同于原基准（Cube均匀起点、Push-T间隔80而非74步），不可跨协议比较绝对成功率；标准误只覆盖骨干种子，不覆盖任务/源组抽样。仅仿真。

papers.title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 tightens the memory value/resource-accounting framework and adds explicit amortized write-cost and ledger/recovery token accounting. The LoCoMo F1 values were already in v1; this revision changes how costs and claims should be interpreted, not the benchmark score. Only a twelve-question diagnostic, not a robot or online-skill-growth benchmark. Archive storage/local-search costs are unmeasured; monetary comparison requires deployment-specific prices. Existing recovery F1 0.329 versus ledger 0.016 must not be advertised as newly added evidence.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2收紧记忆价值/资源核算框架，补充写入成本摊销与账本/恢复的token成本。LoCoMo F1在v1已存在；修订重点是成本及结论解释，不是榜单提升。 仅12题诊断，不是真机或在线技能增长基准；档案存储/本地检索成本未测量，货币比较需部署价格。原有恢复F1 0.329对账本0.016不能说成本次新增证据。

papers.title: SentryVLA: Uncertainty-Guided Action Selection and State Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Robotic Control
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds a formal marginal-coverage proposition and sharply scopes CQR claims to exchangeable frame–candidate calibration samples; it also adds explicit calibration diagnostics and action-score design details. This is a substantive reliability-claim clarification, not a new safety guarantee. The guarantee does not extend to adaptive selected actions, temporally correlated closed-loop states, shifted distributions or task success. Monitoring thresholds and OOD findings remain empirical. No independent reproduction of the calibration experiment.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增边际覆盖命题，并把CQR结论严格限定于可交换的帧—候选校准样本，同时补校准诊断及动作评分设计细节。这是可靠性结论的实质澄清，不是新增安全保证。 保证不延伸到自适应选中动作、时间相关闭环状态、分布偏移或任务成功；监测阈值及OOD结果仍是经验性结论。本次未独立复现校准实验。

papers.title: One-shot Human Video-Guided Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds two adapted video-conditioning baselines, fills previously incomplete ablation results, and replaces the five-trial real-robot table with ten-trial results. Main RoboTwin CapPro performance was already in v1. The added baselines are adaptations to π0.5, not unchanged original systems. Ten trials per physical task remain small; hard sorting succeeds only 20%. One-shot refers to target-time human-video guidance, not training from one demonstration overall; source-task training remains.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增两种改造后视频条件基线，补齐旧版未填完整的消融结果，并以十次试验真机结果替换原五次表格；主要RoboTwin CapPro表现在v1已存在。 新增基线是适配π0.5后的版本，不是原系统原样比较。真机每任务仅10次，困难分类成功率仅20%。one-shot指目标任务测试时的人类视频指导，不代表总共只用一条示范训练；仍需源任务训练。

papers.title: ActECC: Action Chunk Temporal Harnessing for Edge-Cloud Collaborative VLA Inference System
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 changes RAPID into ActECC: the emphasis shifts from edge–cloud partitioning to kinematics-guided usable action-chunk ranges and delay-aware replanning scheduling. It replaces the evaluation with π0.5/GR00T N1.5 system results; the prior 1.73× headline is not directly comparable. Evaluation measures deviation from aligned expert trajectories, explicitly not task success. It is a simulation/system study; cloud-only can have lower latency than ActECC. The two headline maxima arise from different comparisons, and should not be combined into one configuration.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3从RAPID改为ActECC：重点由端云划分转为运动学引导的动作块可用范围与延迟感知重规划调度，并替换为π0.5/GR00T N1.5系统评测；旧1.73倍速度结论不可直接比较。 指标是相对对齐专家轨迹的偏差，明确不是任务成功率；属于仿真/系统评测，cloud-only延迟可能比ActECC更低。两个最大收益来自不同对比，不能拼成单一配置。

papers.title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds Q5/Table 2 comparing sparse offline-to-online learning against directly reusing the SMPC expert cost or demonstration data with FastTD3, IQL and Diffusion Policy. The original hardware results and sparse-reward method are inherited. These baselines reuse the SMPC cost/data, so failure is not evidence that the RL algorithms are generally inferior. The authors attribute it to cost incompatibility and absent corrective examples; SMPC-assisted DAgger is described as too expensive. New comparison is simulation-only.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增Q5/表2：将稀疏奖励离线到在线学习与FastTD3、IQL、Diffusion Policy直接复用SMPC代价或示范数据比较。原真机结果及稀疏奖励方法并非新增。 基线复用SMPC代价/数据，失败不能证明RL算法普遍较差；作者归因于代价不适配和缺少纠偏样本，并指出并行SMPC的DAgger成本过高。新增对比仅仿真。

papers.title: Expert-Play Contouring Control: Faster-than-Demonstration Planning from Slow Expert and Fast Play
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds extensive implementation/evaluation appendices that materially qualify the faster-than-demonstration claims: friction-sweep retraining, success-conditioned phase timing, controller/search budgets and play-mixture provenance. The 13s versus22s real example already appears in v1. The sweep does not isolate zero-shot robustness of one fixed model, and method-specific success subsets can change the timing comparison. No new real-robot aggregate success result was established in this revision; the physical speedup remains an illustrative rollout.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2补充大量实现/评测附录，实质限定超示范速度结论：摩擦扫描的重训练、仅成功样本的分阶段计时、控制器搜索预算及play混合来源。真机13秒对22秒例子在v1已存在。 该扫描不隔离单个固定模型的零样本鲁棒性；各方法成功子集不同会影响计时比较。本次未建立新增真机汇总成功结果，实体速度提升仍为示例rollout。

papers.title: Does "Do Differentiable Simulators Give Better Policy Gradients?" Give Better Policy Gradients?
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 corrects Appendix D’s dimensional-precision analysis and Monte Carlo table for the DDCG versus AoBG test statistics, and clarifies that the result concerns statistic precision rather than optimizer performance. This is a linear-Gaussian toy-statistic correction, not proof of equal scaling in gradient-estimation error or robotics learning performance. Existing optimization/RL results should not be presented as newly added evidence.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2修正附录D中DDCG对AoBG检验统计量的维度精度分析及蒙特卡洛表，并明确该结论针对统计量精度而非优化性能。 这是线性高斯玩具统计量的修正，不能证明梯度估计误差或机器人学习性能具有相同尺度规律；已有优化/RL结果不能算新增证据。

papers.title: Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds Gaussian render-and-compare object tracking via FoundationPose, evaluates dynamics prediction from estimated rather than ground-truth poses, and adds two qualitative real-world recordings. Simulated non-prehensile MPC was already present in v1. Tracking benchmark uses five YCB objects without continuous rotational symmetry, a validation-selected fixed viewpoint and trajectories truncated at visibility failure. Quantitative tracking/prediction remains simulated; real evidence is qualitative, not real MPC success. Reconstruction is a separate prerequisite, and later real predictions miss a contact; training still uses cleaner pose histories.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增基于FoundationPose的高斯渲染对比物体跟踪，评估以估计而非真值位姿输入的动力学预测，并新增两段定性真实场景录像。仿真非抓取MPC在v1已存在。 跟踪基准仅5个无连续旋转对称YCB物体、验证集选定的固定视角，并在可见性失败处截断轨迹。定量跟踪/预测仍在仿真，真机仅定性而非真实MPC成功率。重建是独立前置步骤，后段真机预测漏掉接触，训练位姿历史也更干净。

papers.title: FlowHOI: Flow-based Semantics-Grounded Generation of Hand-Object Interactions for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 turns qualitative robot showcases into a counted baseline comparison and adds matched single-stage, grasp-prefix pretraining, reconstruction and scene-granularity analyses. The 40× inference and 1.7× simulation-success headlines already appeared in v1. Execution is open-loop after offline scene reconstruction, retargeting and DexTrack refinement; these are nominal-condition executability results, not disturbance robustness. Pretraining controls use one training seed and show no clear physical-success gain. Matched single-stage control is 40ms faster with comparable action recognition/simulation success: two-stage gains concern contact quality, not universal superiority.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2将定性机器人展示补为有次数的基线比较，新增匹配单阶段、抓取前缀预训练、重建及场景粒度分析。40倍推理加速和1.7倍仿真成功率主张在v1已存在。 离线场景重建、重定向及DexTrack修正后开环执行；衡量标称条件可执行性而非抗扰。预训练对照单训练种子，未显示明确物理成功增益。匹配单阶段快40ms且动作识别/仿真成功相当，两阶段优势主要是接触质量，非全面更优。

papers.title: What Can One Sentence Fix? A Failure Taxonomy and a Minimal Language Correction for Frozen VLA Policies
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 retitles/reframes CorrectVLA and replaces the small real-robot table with three 10-trial runs per condition, adds long-horizon negative controls, and explicitly separates failure-only retry recovery from all-episode net success. Simulation recoveries of 65/139 and 33/328 are inherited. A person labels the failure mode and writes a timed correction per failing run, taking 40–80 seconds; additional correction rounds may be used. Retry-only simulation success does not establish unconditional policy improvement. The channel fixes magnitude/timing, not missing semantic targets or plans; LIBERO-90 is instruction-OOD, not scene-OOD.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2将CorrectVLA改题并重构论述，以每条件三组10次真机运行替换旧小样本表，新增长程失败对照，明确区分仅失败重试恢复率与全部回合净成功率。仿真65/139及33/328恢复数沿用旧版。 人工标注失败类型并为失败运行编写带时窗纠正，耗时40–80秒，可追加纠正轮次。仅失败重试的仿真成功率不能证明无条件策略提升。该通道只修幅度/时机，不修语义目标或计划；LIBERO-90是指令OOD而非场景OOD。

papers.title: AffordSim: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark for Affordance-Aware Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 adds a real-world domain-randomization sweep, quantitative five-embodiment collection evaluation, and fixed-demo-budget ACT grasp-source controls. The multi-stage success breakdown and original four-task sim-to-real evaluation already appeared in v2. The pose sweep increases demonstrations from 300 to 1,200 to 2,700, so range and data volume are confounded; only one real task and ten trials per setting. Cross-embodiment results concern simulator trajectory collection, not learned policy transfer. Existing headline tables remain unchanged despite collection-count wording changing from 30 to 100 rollouts.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3新增真机域随机化扫描、五形态采集定量评测及等示范预算ACT抓取来源对照。多阶段成功率分解及原四任务sim-to-real评估在v2已存在。 位置扫描示范量从300增至1,200再到2,700，范围与数据量混杂；真机仅单任务、各10次。跨形态结果衡量仿真轨迹采集，不是学习策略迁移。已有主表数字未变，但采集次数文字从30改为100，不能解读为同协议新收益。

papers.title: PRISM: PRior-guided Imagination Sampling in world Models
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds frozen-feature action-prediction probes with random-encoder controls, a diffusion prior using the same fusion interface, ten-seed main simulation evaluation, and matched real-robot prior-free comparisons. Prior-guided Gaussian fusion and the two robot platforms were already in v1. The diffusion and MLP heads use different goal conventions, so their comparison does not isolate architecture. Probe scores come from validation-selected fits, not an independent test split. Head-training/inference figures exclude world-model pretraining and shared encoder/planner costs. Real success gains are four and six episodes; more trials are needed.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增冻结特征动作预测探针及随机编码器对照、共用融合接口的diffusion先验、十种子主仿真评估及匹配真机无先验对照。高斯先验引导融合和两类真机平台在v1已存在。 diffusion和MLP头采用不同目标约定，不能单独归因于架构。探针分数来自验证集选模而非独立测试集。动作头训练/推理数字排除世界模型预训练及共享编码器/规划器成本。真机净增仅4次和6次，仍需更多试验。

papers.title: CRAFT-E: An Interpretable and Editable Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Affordance-Grounded Active Object Retrieval
papers.summary_en: CRAFT-E v1→v2 adds COCO-Tasks transfer, explicit graph-edit interventions and expanded error decomposition. Its verb–property–object graph and real-robot retrieval pipeline predate this revision. COCO transfer measures image grounding, not physical retrieval. Graph edits are selected after inspecting failures on the same set: controllability, not held-out autonomous repair. New text acknowledges full-pipeline differences versus GPT-4o are not significant; supervised COCO methods are contextual, not matched comparators.
papers.summary_zh: CRAFT-E v1→v2新增COCO-Tasks迁移、显式图编辑干预及扩展错误分解；动词—属性—物体图及真机检索流水线并非本次新增。 COCO迁移测图像落地，非实体检索。图编辑在查看同集失败后选择，证明可控性而非留出集自主修复。新文说明完整流水线相对GPT-4o差异不显著；监督COCO方法仅作背景，非匹配对照。

papers.title: A Semantic Autonomy Framework for VLM-Integrated Indoor Mobile Robots: Hybrid Deterministic Reasoning and Cross-Robot Adaptive Memory
papers.summary_en: SAS v1→v2 replaces broad cross-robot success framing with a frozen-implementation audit, sealed instruction challenge and controlled memory-on/memory-off/direct-VLM comparisons; recurrent associations are explicitly stability-tested rather than certified true. Two robot configurations in one indoor environment, with shared-workstation reasoning/memory and deliberate digest installation. Familiar-item scoring uses stored associations; unseen items gain no memory benefit. Replay seeds are not independent tasks, diagnostic probes are selected, and sampled consistency does not prove safe semantic transfer.
papers.summary_zh: SAS v1→v2用冻结实现审计、封存指令挑战及记忆开/关/直接VLM对照替换宽泛跨机器人成功表述；明确重复关联门槛检验稳定性而非保证语义为真。 仅一个室内环境、两种机器人配置，推理/记忆在共享工作站，摘要需主动安装。熟悉题目按已存关联评分，未见题目无记忆收益。重放种子非独立任务，诊断探针经筛选，抽样一致不证明安全语义迁移。

papers.title: Program-Level Adversarial Co-Adaptive Self-Play for Robotic Security
papers.summary_en: Adversarial program co-adaptation produces local recovery but not sustained robustness.
papers.summary_zh: 对抗程序共适应能带来局部恢复，但未建立持续鲁棒性。

papers.title: ASPEN: Adaptive Semantic Reasoning via Command Persistence Prediction for Efficient Navigation VLAs
papers.summary_en: Command-persistence scheduling reduces frozen navigation-VLA calls by 9.5% with similar success.
papers.summary_zh: 命令持续性调度减少9.5%的冻结导航VLA调用，成功率接近。

papers.title: HIDRA: Hierarchical Dual-Routing Attention for Replay-Free Lifelong Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: Hierarchical regularized routing improves replay-free lifelong imitation; current code link is README-only.
papers.summary_zh: 分层正则路由改善无回放终身模仿；当前代码链接仅有README。

papers.title: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding
papers.summary_en: Physical knowledge, grounding and experimental search jointly improve robot programs; real results use stage-completion scoring.
papers.summary_zh: 物理知识、场景落地与实验搜索联合增强程序；真机采用阶段完成评分。

papers.title: When Black-Box Robot Policies Fail: Online Sensor Diagnosis and Repair with a Transparent Surrogate
papers.summary_en: Structured sensor diagnosis improves simulated repair, but clean predictive fit alone does not ensure useful repair.
papers.summary_zh: 结构化传感器诊断改善仿真修复，但干净预测拟合不等于有效修复。

papers.title: Remember Where You Walk: Learning Spatial Memory for End-to-End Legged Robot Exploration
papers.summary_en: Spatial memory improves retained-map reconstruction, not clearly maze coverage; real sensing is externally supplied.
papers.summary_zh: 空间记忆改善地图保留而非明显提升覆盖率；真机感知含外部供给。

papers.title: Retrieve to Act: Motion Primitive Graph Retrieval for Robust VLA Execution
papers.summary_en: Demonstration-graph retrieval enhances frozen-VLA execution, with trained correction modules and important initialization effects.
papers.summary_zh: 示范图检索增强冻结VLA执行，但另训修正模块且初始化校正贡献重要。

papers.title: Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use
papers.summary_en: Admitting diagnostic ambiguity and escalating repairs can outperform forcing a single failure label.
papers.summary_zh: 承认诊断歧义并升级修复，可优于强制单一故障标签。

papers.title: When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies
papers.summary_en: Human timing and correction geometry constrain residual RL around frozen ACT for local precision repair.
papers.summary_zh: 人工时机与纠正几何约束冻结ACT外围残差RL，针对局部精度修复。

papers.title: Evolving Agent Teams
papers.summary_en: Persistent experience and supervisor-driven team restructuring evolve robot code skills around frozen pi0.5; RoboDojo held-out partial-credit score 62.1, with single-run and unmatched robot-budget caveats.
papers.summary_zh: 持久经验与监督驱动团队重组在冻结pi0.5周围演化机器人代码技能；RoboDojo保留种子部分得分62.1，需注意单次运行及机器人比较预算未匹配。

papers.title: E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling
papers.summary_en: Geometry-native future prediction with small-trial real-robot evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 几何原生未来预测，附小样本真机评测。

papers.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
papers.summary_en: Counterfactual world-model tree search improves three physical single-task policies.
papers.summary_zh: 世界模型反事实树搜索改善三项真机单任务策略。

papers.title: SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models
papers.summary_en: Behavior-weighted state supervision modestly improves JEPA planning.
papers.summary_zh: 行为加权状态监督小幅改善JEPA规划。

papers.title: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
papers.summary_en: Universal latent-action video modeling supplies synthetic policy-training data.
papers.summary_zh: 统一latent-action视频模型为策略训练提供合成数据。

papers.title: TAPESTRY: A Single Backbone for Video Generation and Robot Control
papers.summary_en: Shared video-patch action tokens enable one-step action-only deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 共享视频patch动作token实现单步纯动作部署。

papers.title: Trace-WAM: Learning to Act via 3D Motion Prediction for World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Auxiliary future 3D motion improves WAM features without online motion prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 未来三维运动辅助监督改善WAM表示，不增加在线运动预测。

papers.title: GAWM: A Compact Latent World-Action Model for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Compact latent WAM; task-ID and offline real-robot evaluation caveats matter.
papers.summary_zh: 紧凑latent WAM，需注意任务ID与真机离线评估限制。

papers.title: How Much Can Best-of-N Help a World Action Model? Measuring Selectable Headroom and Realizing It in Closed Loop
papers.summary_en: Denoised counterfactual evaluation and fail-gated WAM selection.
papers.summary_zh: 去噪反事实评估与失败门控WAM选择。

papers.title: World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer
papers.summary_en: Workspace-aligned shared world state coordinates multiple robot action streams.
papers.summary_zh: 工作空间共享世界状态协调多机器人动作流。

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.summary_en: World-imagination rewards ground motion-token reasoning across human and robot video.
papers.summary_zh: 世界想象奖励使人机视频共享运动token推理。

papers.title: Calibrated for Which Policy? Conformal Uncertainty for Fixed World Models Under Intervention
papers.summary_en: Policy changes can invalidate fixed world-model uncertainty calibration.
papers.summary_zh: 策略改变也会破坏固定世界模型的不确定性校准。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
papers.summary_en: Training-only foresight can replace visual generation, with target-choice caveats.
papers.summary_zh: 仅训练期未来特征监督可替代视觉生成，需区分目标选择贡献。

papers.title: CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Contact-aware retargeting with tactile replay improves three small real-hand task evaluations.
papers.summary_zh: 接触感知重定向配合触觉回放，在三项小规模真手任务中改善成功率。

papers.title: OpenJaws: An Open Hardware UMI Framework with Stereo Localization for Generalist Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Stereo-localized UMI hardware targets reliable demonstration collection, with two small UR10 policy tests.
papers.summary_zh: 双目定位UMI硬件面向可靠示范采集，并在两项小规模UR10策略任务上验证。

papers.title: RoboSTD: Zero-Shot Single-to-Dual Transfer via Sagittal Mirroring for Bimanual Learning
papers.summary_en: Mirrored single-arm demonstrations plus coordination constraints train bimanual policies without new target bimanual collection.
papers.summary_zh: 镜像单臂示范结合协作约束，在不新增目标双臂采集的条件下训练双臂策略。

papers.title: TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Task-conditioned flow-source shaping improves one-step manipulation policies; benchmark category coverage differs between main and π0.5 experiments.
papers.summary_zh: 任务条件流源塑形改善单步操作策略；主实验与π0.5扩展的评测类别覆盖不同。

papers.title: ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
papers.summary_en: Active visual and tactile calibration supports fine real-world manipulation, with perception/planning confounds in the task comparison.
papers.summary_zh: 主动视觉与触觉校准支持真机精细操作，但任务对照含感知与规划同时变化的混杂因素。

papers.title: From 12 to 200 Demonstrations: How ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$ Scale on a Low-Cost Arm
papers.summary_en: A small-arm scaling study exposes strong adaptation-recipe and evaluation-variance effects rather than universal policy rankings.
papers.summary_zh: 低成本臂扩展实验揭示适配配方与评测波动的重要影响，而非通用策略排名。

papers.title: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: A simulation-trained RL execution layer improves frozen-VLA obstacle handling, with structured perception and residual real collisions.
papers.summary_zh: 仿真训练RL执行层改善冻结VLA避障，但依赖结构化感知且真机仍有碰撞。

papers.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
papers.summary_en: World-model-supervised physical features support a VLA with strong reported simulation scores but no real-task validation.
papers.summary_zh: 世界模型监督物理特征支持VLA取得较高仿真成绩，但尚无真机任务验证。

papers.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
papers.summary_en: Iterative quality relabeling improves successful-trajectory quality and real-task throughput, with online data and conditional-metric caveats.
papers.summary_zh: 迭代质量重标注改善成功轨迹质量与真机吞吐量，但须保留在线数据成本与条件指标限制。

papers.title: Ego-CEVR: Learning Cross-Embodiment Visual Representations from Human Egocentric Videos
papers.summary_en: Separating global future prediction from local action supervision improves transfer; matched robot video remains stronger than human video in real tests.
papers.summary_zh: 分离全局未来预测与局部动作监督改善迁移，但真机对照中等量机器人视频仍强于人类视频。

papers.title: cuArms: GPU-Accelerated Conflict-Based Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation
papers.summary_en: GPU-batched conflict checking and reusable per-arm roadmaps combine multi-arm motion planning with task and schedule search.
papers.summary_zh: 用GPU批量冲突检查与可复用单臂路图，将多臂运动规划接入任务分配及调度搜索。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization
papers.summary_en: Phase-conditioned critics, phase-gated rewards and multi-phase resets train one loco-manipulation policy without human-motion demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: 通过阶段条件critic、阶段门控奖励和多阶段重置，在无需人类动作示范的条件下训练统一移动操作策略。

papers.title: Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization
papers.summary_en: A stochastic discrete motion tokenizer connects autoregressive motion composition to a latent-conditioned whole-body tracking policy.
papers.summary_zh: 随机离散动作tokenizer连接自回归动作组合与潜变量条件全身跟踪策略。

papers.title: Mimetic Embodiment Transfer of Human-Humanoid Interaction from In-the-Wild Videos
papers.summary_en: HumiTransfer preserves interaction-relative geometry while retargeting human videos and optimizing balance/contact; HumiMimic supplies human–humanoid motion data.
papers.summary_zh: HumiTransfer重定向人类视频时保持交互相对几何，并优化平衡/接触；HumiMimic提供人—人形动作数据。

papers.title: Keeping Contact: Task-Adaptive Friction Margins for Bimanual Non-Prehensile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Signed friction-distance margins adapt planned contact forces to task-dependent pivot moment deviations in bimanual tilting.
papers.summary_zh: 以有符号摩擦距离构造随任务力矩变化的裕度，用于双臂倾斜接触力规划。
