papers.title: Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer
papers.summary_en: M-PACT factorizes reusable primitive motion codes and adapts an embodiment-specific decoder; contextual models predict the next primitive.
papers.summary_zh: M-PACT将可复用动作原语代码与本体专属解码器分离，并由上下文模型预测下一原语。

papers.title: Predict the Swing, Match the Speed: Robotic Pipe Stabbing With Learned Stereo Vision and Residual Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: StabBot combines stereo swing estimation, velocity-matched interception and residual RL for suspended-pipe insertion.
papers.summary_zh: StabBot结合双目摆动估计、速度匹配截获与残差RL处理悬挂管件插入。

papers.title: Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Constraint-Referenced Strategy projects commanded end-effector twist onto a known joint axis to separate intended progress from off-axis waste.
papers.summary_zh: Constraint-Referenced Strategy将指令末端twist投影到已知关节轴，区分沿约束进展与离轴浪费。

papers.title: Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well
papers.summary_en: A sim-trained LEAP pose-reaching policy uses diverse grasp resets and friction curricula, with an adjustable learned residual safety filter.
papers.summary_zh: 仿真训练LEAP手内位姿到达策略，采用多样抓取重置与摩擦课程，并叠加可调学习式残差安全滤波器。

papers.title: Bridging Exploration and Loss of Plasticity in On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: Analysis links collapsing Gaussian exploration variance in PPO to sharp/low-rank loss geometry and loss of plasticity; resetting variance helps adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 分析将PPO高斯探索方差塌缩与尖锐/低秩损失几何及可塑性丧失联系，并用方差重置改善适应。

papers.title: GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers
papers.summary_en: Geometry-aware residual adaptation preserves frozen whole-body foundation trackers while learning terrain execution, then distills privileged terrain observations into an onboard-depth adapter.
papers.summary_zh: 几何感知残差适应保持全身基础跟踪器冻结，学习地形执行，再将特权地形观测蒸馏为机载深度适配器。

papers.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
papers.summary_en: Skill Dreaming evolves repository skills from validated pull-request streams, including alignment of stale or conflicting instructions.
papers.summary_zh: Skill Dreaming 从已验证 PR 流中演化仓库技能，并对陈旧或冲突指令进行对齐。

papers.title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
papers.summary_en: Separates retrieval coverage from stale-fact interference when an agent must use updated memory.
papers.summary_zh: 将检索到最新事实与生成阶段受过时事实干扰这两个问题分开检验。

papers.title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
papers.summary_en: RuHarness co-evolves diagnostic rubrics and executable harnesses while keeping the task objective fixed.
papers.summary_zh: RuHarness 在固定任务目标下共同演化诊断 rubric 与可执行 harness。

papers.title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks? Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution
papers.summary_en: BiPA audits skill optimizers using unchanged-candidate selection controls and bipartite attribution of context costs.
papers.summary_zh: BiPA 用不编辑候选的选择对照及二部图上下文成本归因，审计技能优化器。

papers.title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.summary_en: Models information loss across an agent harness pipeline rather than treating nominal context-window length as usable evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 将 agent harness 的信息损失拆为处理流水线，而非把上下文窗口长度等同于可用证据量。

papers.title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
papers.summary_en: MoGAP adds training-only asymmetric motion-guided noise prediction to video world models without an external teacher or extra inference branch.
papers.summary_zh: MoGAP 为视频世界模型增加仅训练时使用的运动引导非对称噪声预测，不引入外部教师或额外推理分支。

papers.title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
papers.summary_en: Select-TTT uses the frozen language-model head to score query relevance and reweight in-place fast-weight updates without adding parameters.
papers.summary_zh: Select-TTT 用冻结语言模型输出头评估查询相关性，重加权原位 fast-weight 更新，不增加参数。

papers.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
papers.summary_en: Separates faithful dynamics from reward attainment using latent rollout consistency and dynamics equivariance.
papers.summary_zh: 以潜空间 rollout 一致性及动力学等变性区分动力学忠实度与任务回报。

papers.title: CoHARL: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Executable Harnesses with Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: CoHARL jointly trains one shared policy and evolves a population of executable harnesses under fixed evaluators and action families.
papers.summary_zh: CoHARL 在固定评估器和动作族下共同训练共享策略并演化可执行 harness 种群。

papers.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
papers.summary_en: Studies how an agent interface changes both its attainable return and the mismatch of an already trained policy.
papers.summary_zh: 研究 agent 接口如何同时改变可达回报上界与既有策略的不匹配程度。

papers.title: Evaluation-Guided Demonstration Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies: The Winning Entry in the MetaFine Open Competition
papers.summary_en: Task-specific pi0.5 policies combine nominal demonstrations, expert corrections from policy states, and evaluation-guided demonstration refinement.
papers.summary_zh: 任务专用 pi0.5 策略结合常规示范、策略状态上的专家纠正，以及评测驱动的示范细化。

papers.title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary_en: OmniBrain-0 consolidates expert agent trajectories into one high-level model with on-policy distillation and rubric-guided self-improvement, retaining specialist low-level skills.
papers.summary_zh: OmniBrain-0 以 on-policy 蒸馏和 rubric 引导自改进将专家 agent 轨迹整合为统一高层模型，仍保留专用低层技能。

papers.title: Experience Memory Graph: Extracting Reusable Correction Knowledge from Agent Trajectories
papers.summary_en: v3 substantially rewrites Experience Memory Graph around reusable correction knowledge extracted by aligning failed exploration and expert-success trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: v3 大幅重写 Experience Memory Graph，以失败探索与专家成功轨迹对齐来提取可复用纠正知识。

papers.title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary_en: v2 substantially revises MemPrism: a persistent event store is separated from temporary task-conditioned relational memory views.
papers.summary_zh: v2 实质修订 MemPrism：将持久事件存储与任务条件化的临时关系记忆视图分离。

papers.title: Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory
papers.summary_en: Iris v2 adds state-conditioned, separately encoded visual candidates with a shared forked-state cache for typed decisions.
papers.summary_zh: Iris v2 增加状态条件化的逐候选视觉编码，并共享分叉状态缓存以支持类型化决策。

papers.title: What Makes Video World Model Latents Action-Relevant: Prediction over Reconstruction
papers.summary_en: v2 adds action-shuffled and forward-dynamics controls across all 26 held-out LIBERO tasks to study action relevance beyond reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh: v2 在全部 26 个留出 LIBERO 任务增加动作打乱和前向动力学对照，检验重建之外的动作相关性。

papers.title: MemWM: Associative Memory-Enhanced Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.summary_en: MemWM v2 clarifies shared memory/action-conditioned prediction, parameter accounting and planning-budget comparisons.
papers.summary_zh: MemWM v2 澄清共享的记忆/动作条件预测、参数核算与规划预算比较。

papers.title: VisCurate: Evaluating Behavioral Equivalence of Visual Skills
papers.summary_en: VisCurate v2 strengthens protocol disclosure for visual skill-library curation, including disjoint calibration and sandbox admission of edits.
papers.summary_zh: VisCurate v2 加强视觉技能库整理的协议披露，包括不相交校准与编辑的沙箱准入。

papers.title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
papers.summary_en: Latent world-model policy improvement within a frozen VLM; simulated interactive-agent evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结VLM内部的潜在世界模型策略改进，证据来自仿真交互Agent。

papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary_en: Capability-organized harness evolution with CaP-X/SOON robot transfer; configuration-level, small-sample evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 按能力组织Harness演化并迁移到CaP-X/SOON真机；证据是小样本整套配置比较。

papers.title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A low-cost-arm benchmark directly tests code-agent/VLA complementarity under controlled adaptation budgets and real-robot ranking checks.
papers.summary_zh: 低成本臂基准在控制适配预算并核对真机排序的条件下，直接检验代码Agent与VLA的互补作用。

papers.title: LabWorld: Learning Interactive 4D Worlds for Scientific Experimentation
papers.summary_en: Event-conditioned laboratory reconstruction exposes the mismatch between image agreement and modeled interaction validity, without downstream robot validation.
papers.summary_zh: 事件条件实验室重建揭示图像一致性与所建模交互有效性的差异，尚无下游机器人验证。

papers.title: TS-DP: Reinforcement Speculative Decoding For Temporal Adaptive Diffusion Policy Acceleration
papers.summary_en: Substantive v2 adds real-time manipulation and fidelity evidence, with NFE accounting explicitly separated from wall-clock speed.
papers.summary_zh: 实质性v2新增实时操作与保真证据，并明确区分NFE计量和实测时延。

papers.title: Learning to Feel the Future: DreamTacVLA for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v4→v5 clarifies that a lightweight action-conditioned forecasting MLP predicts tactile latents while the pretrained tactile world model stays frozen; it adds capacity/data scaling and an explicit limitations section.
papers.summary_zh: v4→v5明确由轻量动作条件MLP预测触觉潜变量、预训练触觉世界模型保持冻结，并补充模型/数据扩展与局限分析。

papers.title: DeFM: Learning Foundation Representations from Depth for Robotics
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 revises depth-encoder segmentation probe tables and makes the hyperparameter protocol explicit rather than introducing a new robot-control result.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3修订深度编码器分割探针表，并明确超参数协议；不是新增机器人控制结果。

papers.title: RePO-VLA: Recovery-Driven Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 expands recovery-data causal-confusion analysis, matched-budget value-supervision controls, and blinded real-robot perturbation protocols.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2扩充恢复数据因果混淆分析、等预算价值监督对照，以及真机盲测扰动协议。

papers.title: Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 strengthens failure-attribution audits, matched data-budget controls, threshold sensitivity, and the boundary between operational responsibility and physical causality.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2补充失败归因审计、等数据预算对照和阈值敏感性，明确操作责任与物理因果并不等价。

papers.title: FAWAM: Force-Aware World Action Models for Closed-Loop Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 adds residual-correction baselines under matched intervention budgets and clarifies the no-prediction residual ablation.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3加入匹配人工干预预算的残差修正基线，并澄清无预测残差消融。

papers.title: FTP-1: A Generalist Foundation Tactile Policy Across Tactile Sensors for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v3→v4 specifies the 22-joint Sharpa-to-32-slot action mapping and adds tactile-feature probes and joint data/compute scaling experiments.
papers.summary_zh: v3→v4明确Sharpa的22关节到32槽位动作映射，并补充触觉特征探针及数据/算力共同扩展实验。

papers.title: From Grasps to Dexterity: Large-Scale Grasp Pretraining for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds UniDex-VLA/Dex1B comparisons, synthesized-trajectory amount/composition ablations, an oracle-subgoal comparison, and explicit Shadow-to-LEAP adaptation details.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2增加UniDex-VLA/Dex1B对照、合成轨迹规模/组成消融、oracle子目标对照及Shadow到LEAP适配细节。

papers.title: When Does Test-Time Physical Diagnosis Pay?
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 changes the diagnosis of transfer failure: full-trace deployment inputs lie outside the frozen decoder’s training range and collapse its responses.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2重新定位迁移失败原因：完整轨迹部署输入超出冻结解码器训练范围，使其输出塌缩为常数答案。

papers.title: When Do Discrete Actions Make Good Continuous Controllers?
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 sharpens the interpretation of alternative action tokenizers by comparing complete operating points and distinguishing guided from unguided discrete regression.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2按完整运行配置重新解释动作tokenizer结果，并区分有引导与无引导离散回归。

papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 corrects the dataset description by removing the claim of serialized initial states for exact reset replay and highlights ranking reversals across domains and metrics.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2删去数据含可精确重置初始状态的声明，并强调跨域及不同指标的排名翻转。

papers.title: Semantic World Models
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds no-base-policy planning, question phrasing/weighting ablations, VLM-generated supervision checks, task decomposition, and explicit planning-cost measurements.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增无基础策略规划、问题措辞/权重消融、VLM生成监督验证、任务分解及明确规划成本测量。

papers.title: AWARE: Action-Entropy-Weighted and Attention-Guided Retrieval of Observation Evidence for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 replaces coarse uncertainty gating with element-wise entropy/depth-weighted observation retrieval and adds diagnostic alternatives and expanded matched-checkpoint evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3以逐动作元素熵/深度加权观测检索替代粗粒度门控，补充诊断替代方案及匹配checkpoint评估。

papers.title: GARV: Graph-Aware Refinement and Safety Verification for High-Level Robot Plans
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 extends a hidden-path hazard audit into route-set certification and minimum-cost safe refinement with graph-grounded action contracts.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2从隐藏路径风险审计扩展为基于图动作契约的路径集合认证及最小成本安全细化。

papers.title: Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds the performance-gap derivation and implementation-level definitions for state-criticality baselines and real-robot adversarial residual learning.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2补充性能差距推导、状态关键性基线定义及真机对抗残差学习实现细节。
